goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/nitrogen/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.MolecularWeight and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_NITROGEN_MW.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/hydrogen/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.MolecularWeight and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_HYDROGEN_MW.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/ammonia/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.MolecularWeight and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_AUTHORITATIVE_AMMONIA_MW.json. Calculate the stoichiometric predicted ammonia molecular weight using predicted_ammonia_mw = (nitrogen_mw + 3 * hydrogen_mw) / 2. Determine whether the predicted and authoritative ammonia scalars differ by at most 0.05.

required_result.producer_result: The final bounded numeric relation artifact emitted by the compiled controller plan.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch the three exact PubChem URLs outside the Brain producer, independently parse MolecularWeight, recompute predicted_ammonia_mw=(N2+3*H2)/2 with Python arithmetic, recompute the absolute difference and <=0.05 predicate, and compare every consequential relation field.
